blind.description: A heavy stone altar or sacrificial table composed of a thick rectangular slab top supported by two sturdy, molded rectangular pillar pedestals at either end. The top slab features a grooved perimeter trough/runnel with small drain notches on the sides. Surfaces are completely solid, watertight, and continuous. The model stands flat on the floor on its two base pedestals without an added plinth. Materials resemble aged, weathered dark bronze or slate-grey stone with faint reddish-brown painted or stone inlay bands around the lower pedestal sections and worn edge highlights.
blind.from_above: A simple horizontal rectangle with rounded corners, featuring a thin recessed rectangular border groove and small drainage notches on the short ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly waist height (about 2.5 to 3 ft tall); the length is roughly equal to the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 5 to 5.5 ft long).
